sloka: राजन् वनमिदं दुर्गं तव भग्नं दुरात्मना ।वानरेण ह्यविज्ञाय तव वीर्यं महाबल ।। ५.५८.१११ ।।।।
transliteration: rājan vanamidaṁ durgaṁ tava bhagnaṁ durātmanā ।vānareṇa hyavijñāya tava vīryaṁ mahābala ।। 5.58.111 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O powerful king an evilminded vanara has destroyed the inaccessible pleasure garden not knowing your valour.
